Text box remapping QWERTY keypresses to Dvorak output live, with on-screen Dvorak layout highlight and words-per-minute counter.

Plays synthesized retro computer bleeps and bloops on every tap, click and keypress; several sound sets and volume.

Falling-block game that never speeds up; choose a fixed speed, play indefinitely, pause anytime, keyboard and touch.

Idle game played inside a mini spreadsheet: write cell formulas to automate production, unlocking functions that teach real spreadsheet skills.
Short canvas game starting in darkness navigated by sound; collect upgrades revealing echoes, outlines, color, then x-ray vision.
Add items, tap plus/minus to count, set low-stock alerts, search, export CSV; stored locally.
Type items with prices, tick who shares each; outputs what each person owes including shared tax or discount.
Log weaknesses and the lesson for each; shows a random lesson on open and a daily review list; local storage.
Enter take-home pay and hours; type any price to see it in hours and days of your working life.

Plain-language one-paragraph explainers of everyday tech terms (Wi-Fi, cloud, browser, phishing, updates), searchable, large print.
On-screen and keyboard-playable piano synthesizing piano, organ and choir-like vowel voices; sustain, octave shift.
Build a named list of links; step through them in order with next and previous, mark visited; local storage.

Load a local video or image, drag four corners to warp it for projection mapping, play fullscreen.

Sticky notes grouped per person recording what you told them and when; search, filter by person, local storage.

Control a dog to herd a flock with flocking rules into a pen across timed levels.

Quiz of common misconceptions, true or false, with the short correct explanation after each; score and shuffle.
Small first-person raycast shooter across a 1932 Australian wheat field where emus dodge and outnumber you.

Branching text adventure as a reality TV contestant; producers twist choices, ratings meter, multiple endings.

Tap to play synthesized traffic noise, honks and a breaking-up line effect to end a phone call.

Enter word lists per reel; pull the lever to spin and combine random words into idea prompts.
